test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Study the following number arrangement and answer the question given below. All numbers given below are 2 digit numbers. 74 45 76 56 52 54 36 28 43 78 25 59 48 36 85 86 94 87 What will be 70% of the mean score of the numbers in this above series?
solution:
**Given:**

Number series: 74, 45, 76, 56, 52, 54, 36, 28, 43, 78, 25, 59, 48, 36, 85, 86, 94, 87

**Formula Used:**

Mean score = Sum of all numbers / Total number of numbers

70% of the mean score = 0.7 × Mean score

**Calculation:**

Sum of all numbers = 74 + 45 + 76 + 56 + 52 + 54 + 36 + 28 + 43 + 78 + 25 + 59 + 48 + 36 + 85 + 86 + 94 + 87

Sum of all numbers = 1062

Total number of numbers = 18

Mean score = 1062 / 18

Mean score = 59

70% of the mean score = 0.7 × 59

⇒ 70% of the mean score = 41.3

**The 70% of the mean score of the numbers in the given series is 41.3.**
